message.content:
This editorial illustration features a large, reddish-orange hand in the upper right, its fingers gripping a small square tile labeled with the letter "A." The hand extends over a game board that resembles Scrabble, tilted at an angle. The board has a grid of squares in varying shades of light tan, muted blue, and red. Several blank tiles are already placed on the board. Below the board, two wooden-style red racks hold letter tiles. The top rack contains tiles spelling "KISRUH." The bottom rack holds tiles spelling "BR" and "IN," with a gap between them where the "A" tile currently held by the hand would logically fit.

At the top, the large red text "TEMPO" dominates. Smaller text below it reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" and "LIPUTAN KHUSUS TOKOH SENI 2021 H.38." A barcode, QR code, and price information are in the top right corner. In the bottom right, a paragraph of Indonesian text begins with "Melenceng dari desain awal..." and ends with "H.90." The background is a solid teal-blue color.
